info.title: API.SH: CJdropshipping
info.description: The CJdropshipping API from API.SH: public CJdropshipping data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The CJdropshipping category tree (three levels): each category's id, name, level, parent and children. Pass `parent_id` for one category's children. Use the ids as `category_id` in search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cjdropshipping-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One CJdropshipping product: SKU, name, link, image, price range, listing count, category with its path, order count, units sold, refunds, dispute rate, latest order date, review and question counts, customization flag, and every variant with its SKU, total stock, stock by country and by warehouse (CJ and factory stock), orders and dispute rate.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cjdropshipping-product

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: X8 MAX Smart Watch Bluetooth Calling Sports

get.description:
Buyers' questions about a CJdropshipping product and the supplier's answers: question, rating, SKU, date, the asker's first name plus display name and picture as the product page shows them, and each answer with its date and the answering supplier. Page with `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cjdropshipping-questions

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Buyer reviews of a CJdropshipping product: rating, text, date, reviewer (as the site masks it), country and photos, with the total. Filter by star rating. Page with `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cjdropshipping-reviews

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars (1-5).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search the CJdropshipping catalogue: product id, SKU, name, link, image, price range (USD), discount price, how many stores list it, warehouse stock, verified-warehouse and free-shipping flags, video flag, category and supplier id, with the total, related categories and the warehouse countries that stock the results. Filter by category, price, ship-from warehouse country, verified warehouse stock and free shipping. Page with `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cjdropshipping-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words or a CJ SKU (required unless `category_id` is set).

parameters.name: warehouse
parameters.description: Ship-from warehouse country code from /cjdropshipping/v1/warehouses, e.g. `US`, `CN`, `DE`.

parameters.name: verified_warehouse
parameters.description: `true` for products with verified warehouse stock only.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

A CJdropshipping product's stock in each warehouse (China, US, Europe, Thailand...): warehouse, country, stock, verified and factory stock, for the whole product or one variant.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cjdropshipping-stock

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The countries CJdropshipping ships from: country code, name (also in German, French, Chinese and Thai) and area id. Use the codes as `warehouse` in search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cjdropshipping-warehouses

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
